purpose: Freezing thresholds without freezing how they are measured leaves the measurement method as an open loophole. This file freezes the measurement while lock.json remains the sole lifecycle authority.

canonicalExecutor.dtypeWidenNote: DTYPE_WIDEN remains in the artifact transformation enum for future protocols but is not used in this MVP: nothing is ever narrower than float64, so there is nothing to widen and no derivative-precision ambiguity to argue about.

determinism.threadCount: fixed and recorded in each ExperimentRun
determinism.crossHardwareDrift: Bitwise drift across different hardware is a Gate 6 finding, not a suite failure.

canonicalExecutor.rationale: The problem is tiny; there is no performance case for float32. Unifying on float64 removes the DTYPE_WIDEN and derivative-precision semantics disputes entirely. Complex PINNs may reintroduce mixed precision under a future protocol version — not this one.

generatorProvenance.hashInputBytes: C-order little-endian float64 node payload immediately followed by the weight payload

quadrature.rationale: A continuous (quadrature) norm rather than a bare discrete sum: a discrete sum drifts with grid density, which would leave the measurement method open.

generatorProvenance.numpyVersion: 2.4.5 (independent recomputation only; frozen-artifact validation does not call NumPy)
generatorProvenance.hashInputBytes: exact 16000-byte C-order little-endian float64 data payload; runtime validation reads the frozen NPY artifact rather than calling cos

rejectedAlternatives.reason: Contains x = 1/2 at j=1000 (measured deviation 5.551e-17, about one ULP) because the interval count 2000 is even and cos(pi/2) is hit exactly. That collides with the B4 collocation set {1/4, 1/2, 3/4} and would false-trigger the L1 leakage identity check.
Interval count 1998 is even; contains x = 1/2 for the same reason.

boundarySet.evaluation: exact endpoint values; a nearby grid node must never be substituted

antiCollision.requirement: min over v in (GL512 union CGL2000), over 2 <= d <= 64, over 1 <= i < d, of |v - i/d|  >  1e-12
antiCollision.status: MUST, checked by PRELOCK_VALIDATION and re-run whenever any frozen node artifact changes
antiCollision.rationale: It is not sufficient to assume quadrature nodes are irrational and therefore safe. CGL with 2001 nodes is a counterexample.

leakageProtocol.definition: The delta_min = 1e-6 exclusion zone from an earlier draft is withdrawn. PINNs live on a continuous domain; a training point being geometrically near a validation point is not data leakage. Leakage is an information-flow property.

checks.name: sample identity
checks.test: No holdout validation coordinate appears in a training-side set after removing spec-known boundary coordinates.
checks.criterion: canonical float64 bit-pattern equality, or ulp_distance <= 8 to absorb benign re-serialisation only
checks.boundaryRule: Training BC may reuse {0,1}; CGL endpoints {0,1} are excluded from L1 identity comparison. This exception never permits a boundary validation metric to feed a forbidden L4 consumer.

checks.name: coordinate provenance
checks.test: Validation coordinates must come from this protocol's deterministic generator.
checks.criterion: generatorId equals GL512 or CGL2000 or BOUNDARY; never a training-side generator

checks.name: generation provenance
checks.test: The validation set must not be derived from any training artifact.
checks.criterion: parentArtifactIds of the validation set contain no training-side artifact

checks.name: consumer provenance
checks.test: Recorded readers of validation coordinates and validation metrics.

leakageIsEstablishedIfAny: a non-boundary holdout coordinate from GL512 or CGL2000 was added to training (L1)
a validation artifact was read by the optimizer or adaptive sampler (L4)
a validation metric influenced early stopping (L4)
a validation result influenced loss weighting, architecture or hyperparameter selection (L4)
leakageProtocol.onLeakage: Gate 5 = FAIL and STOP THE LINE
leakageProtocol.auditNote: The third condition is exactly the defect found in pinns/main.py:1036-1040, where should_stop() depended on profile_ok computed on the plotting grid. The withdrawn distance-based definition would not have caught it; this one does.

aliasingResolution._separateFrom: leakageProtocol — one asks whether information flowed back from validation to training, the other asks whether the validation grid can see the error at all
aliasingResolution.requirement: Both node sets must resolve sinusoidal modes up to minResolvedMode, and must satisfy antiCollision.

derivativeEvaluation.forbidden: finite differences — they would mix discretisation error into AC-6, AC-7 and AC-8

numerics.epsilonAssertion: denominator > 1e6 * epsilon must hold for every ratio, so epsilon never materially affects a reported value
numerics.endpointTreatment: Gauss-Legendre is an open rule and excludes endpoints, which is correct for integrals; endpoints are checked separately and exactly by AC-3 and AC-6

evaluationSeed.reason: All evaluation grids are deterministic quadrature and interpolation nodes; no sampling is performed at evaluation time, so there is no seed to record.

gate2a.name: primary reference verification
gate2a.note: Mathematically u*(0) = u*(1) = 0 exactly. Numerically sin(pi_float64) = 1.224647e-16, so the implementation must NOT require a literal == 0 comparison. tol_bc = 1e-14 leaves an 81.7x margin over the measured value.

fdmProtocol.name: Gate 2b — independent numerical baseline subsystem verification
fdmProtocol.roleNote: The primary reference is the analytic solution. The FDM baseline verifies that the baseline subsystem itself works; a discretised solution with truncation error must never replace an exact solution that already exists.

error.definition: E(N) = max over i in 1..N-1 of |u_i - u*(x_i)|
error.norm: discrete maximum error at interior nodes

must: E(N) strictly decreasing across the whole sequence
1.8 <= p_k <= 2.2 for each of the final K=4 refinement pairs
fdmProtocol.roundoffNote: At N <= 2048 in float64 the rounding floor is far from reached, so the order estimates are not contaminated by roundoff.
fdmProtocol.independence: The baseline module must not import any PINN module; enforced by a CI dependency-direction check.
fdmProtocol.b11Note: A single grid has no convergence order at all. The strawman case B11 (N=4 only) must therefore be judged 'Gate 2 FAIL: required refinement sequence absent, convergence evidence does not exist'. It must NOT be reported as 'measured order outside [1.8, 2.2]' — that would be reporting a quantity that was never computed (Articles 39 and 40).

seeds.note: The generating rule is declared alongside the values so the choice is evidently not post-hoc.

suiteLevelRequirement.statement: All five preregistered seeds pass Gate 5 independently.
suiteLevelRequirement.onPartialPass: Each passing run still reaches SUPPORTED @ C2; each failing run is a Gate 5 FAIL with a FailureRecord; the C3 robustness claim is NOT_SUPPORTED (not REFUTED); the core suite is FAIL. A failing seed must not downgrade the C2 status of the seeds that passed.
c3Scope: fixed architecture as recorded in the run
fixed optimizer and schedule as recorded in the run
suiteLevelRequirement.c3ScopeProhibition: Must not be generalised to 'PINN generally robust' (Article 35).
